paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Average overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs across both KGDS patterns. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{avg} [61, 69]), Tier-2 (OP_{avg} [53, 56]), and Tier-3 (OP_{avg} [29, 37]).

model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the average performance of large language models across knowledge-grounded discussion summarization patterns. The horizontal axis displays categories labeled Tier-1, Tier-2, Tier-3, and additional unlabeled categories, ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis represents Average Performance (%), with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick labels at 10-unit intervals. There are nine bars in total, each a shade of gray or blue. The first bar, labeled Tier-1, is gray and extends to approximately 61.11%. The second bar is blue and measures approximately 68.66%. The third bar, labeled Tier-2, is gray and reaches 55.69%. The fourth bar has a value of 66.41%. The fifth bar, labeled Tier-3, is tan and measures approximately 36.62%. The sixth bar has a value of 62.98%. The seventh bar has a value of 65.77%. The eighth bar has a value of 55.30%. The ninth bar has a value of 55.55%. No bars are visibly emphasized, and no annotations are present.
model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the average performance of large language models across knowledge-grounded discussion summarization patterns. The horizontal axis displays categories labeled Tier-1 through Tier-3, presented in an ascending order. The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick labels displayed at 10-unit intervals. There are eight bars, each representing a tier, and they are colored individually in shades of gray, teal, and brown. The first bar, representing Tier-1, is a dark gray color and extends to approximately 61.11%. The second bar, also representing Tier-1, is a light teal and extends to approximately 68.66%. The third bar, representing Tier-2, is a light gray and extends to approximately 66.41%. The fourth bar, representing Tier-2, is a dark teal and extends to approximately 62.98%. The fifth bar, representing Tier-2, is a light blue and extends to approximately 65.77%. The sixth bar, representing Tier-3, is a light blue and extends to approximately 55.69%. The seventh bar, representing Tier-3, is a light tan and extends to approximately 55.30%. The eighth bar, representing Tier-3, is a brown color and extends to approximately 29.44%. No bars are visibly emphasized or annotated.
